ITEM 1 | Two rectangular pieces of flatbread-like crust with golden-brown browned edges, topped with red tomato sauce and melted white cheese in a scattered layer, each piece about 7 x 5 cm and 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the upper left of the plate | 140
ITEM 2 | Dark brown, slightly glossy roasted meat chunk with rough, crusted surface and irregular edges, about 4 x 3 cm and 2.5 cm high, at the upper right near the drumstick | 60
ITEM 3 | Roasted chicken drumstick with pale tan-to-golden skin, some red sauce or glaze smeared on the lower portion, moist-looking, about 9 cm long and 4 cm thick, lying diagonally at the upper right | 110
ITEM 4 | Chopped leafy salad of dark green and pale yellow-green romaine-style leaves with creamy pale dressing coating and clinging to them, moist, slightly wilted, forming a mound about 12 x 9 cm and 3 cm high at the left center | 90
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellow-green lettuce wedge or leaf piece with creamy dressing on it, lying at the lower left edge, about 5 x 4 cm and 1.5 cm high | 25
ITEM 6 | Small pale whitish-tan piece of cooked food with a rough texture, partly hidden under the salad near the lower center-left, about 2.5 x 2 cm | 8
ITEM 7 | Cauliflower florets, pale creamy white with slightly yellow-tinged edges, firm and bumpy, clustered in a mound about 9 x 8 cm and 3.5 cm high at the center right | 110
ITEM 8 | Brussels sprouts, dark olive-green to brown, roasted with charred, slightly shiny outer leaves, halved or whole, three to four pieces each about 3 cm across, at the right near the chicken | 70
ITEM 9 | Yellow-orange rice with separate grains, dry and fluffy with small flecks of red-orange seasoning, forming a loose mound about 8 x 7 cm and 2 cm high at the lower right | 95
ITEM 10 | Scattered loose rice grains and orange seasoning specks on the white plate surface along the lower right edge | 8
